text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ

translations.asad: READ in the name of thy Sustainer, who has-
translations.sahih: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -

translations.asad: created man out of a germ-cell
translations.sahih: Created man from a clinging substance.

translations.asad: Read - for thy Sustainer is the Most Bountiful One
translations.sahih: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

translations.asad: who has taught [man] the use of the pen –
taught man what he did not know!
translations.sahih: Taught man that which he knew not.

translations.asad: Nay, verily, man becomes grossly overweening
whenever he believes himself to be self-sufficient:
for, behold, unto thy Sustainer all must return.
translations.sahih: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

translations.asad: HAST THOU ever considered him who tries to prevent
translations.sahih: Have you seen the one who forbids

translations.asad: Hast thou considered whether he is on the right way,
translations.sahih: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

translations.asad: Hast thou considered whether he may [not] be giving the lie to the truth and turning his back [upon it]?
translations.sahih: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

translations.asad: Does he, then, not know that God sees [all]?
translations.sahih: Does he not know that Allah sees?

text.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ

translations.asad: Nay, if he desist not, We shall most surely drag him down upon his forehead
translations.sahih: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -

translations.asad: and then let him summon [to his aid] the counsels of his own [spurious] wisdom,
translations.sahih: Then let him call his associates;

translations.asad: [the while] We shall summon the forces of heavenly chastisement!
translations.sahih: We will call the angels of Hell.

translations.asad: Nay, pay thou no heed to him, but prostrate thyself [before God] and draw close [unto Him]!
translations.sahih: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
